name: Long March 6A
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: LC-9A is up to 10 launches this year, and 29 since its first in 2022. Its previous launch was 29 days earlier.
slot_b_text: The 49th launch of the year for China's CASC, 619th all time. That is a launch every six days. No Long March 6A has failed in 27 flights. Worldwide, it is attempt number 248 of the year.
rocket_fact: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
